page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. It provides 64 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 128.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 2.0 GB of RAM allocated per core.

The instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for operational file systems and persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a 28 Gbps baseline throughput interface. There are no integrated hardware graphics accelerators, dedicating all system resources entirely to central processor execution.

By maintaining a lean memory footprint relative to its 64 processing cores, the instance maximizes CPU resource density while avoiding costs tied to unutilized RAM. This hardware profile is configured for compute-intensive tasks, such as batch data processing, distributed compilation, media transcoding, scientific simulations, and high-concurrency application tiers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance based on the KVM hypervisor, designed for workloads that demand heavy CPU capacity without excessive memory overhead. It is equipped with 64 dedicated x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C virtual CPUs operating at 3.2 GHz and 128.0 GB of memory, delivering a focused 2.0 GB per vCPU ratio. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 28 Gbps, facilitating rapid inter-node communication in distributed environments. The server does not feature local storage or GPU hardware accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage for persistent storage operations. By prioritizing raw processor density over oversized memory arrays, this configuration provides cost-efficient execution for compute-intensive tasks. Key operational targets include continuous integration and build pipelines, batch data transformations, media transcoding, scientific modeling, and high-concurrency web serving tiers.
